subject: general
question:
Observe the given bar graph and answer the question.

The bar graph shows the profit made by a certain textile company (in million $).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4144d3765763b9b8be4225b0a66977704f55a6fa99a80e864b57f07ebec3a7f.png] 

 

Which of the following is NOT true about the company's profits from 2012-13 to 2017-18?

options.text: The company has recorded drop in profits for only one of the five years.
The company has recorded the same increase in profits in $ terms for the past two years.
Total Profit of the company for the period is 160 Million $
The company has recorded profits greater than or equal to 30 Million $ for four out of five years.

solution:
Given :-

Profit given by textile company in different years (million)

2012-2013 = 30

2013-2014 = 36

2014-2015 = 28

2016 -2017 = 32

2017-2018 = 36

Calculation :-

⇒ The company has recorded drop in profits for only one of the five years (statement is true because year 2013-2014 → 2014-2015 profit drop)

⇒ The company has recorded the same increase in profits in $ terms for the past two years (statement is true because year 2012-2013 → 2013-2014 & 2016 -2017 → 2017-2018 same increase in profit)

⇒ Total Profit of the company for the period is 160 Million $(statement is incorrect because Total Profit of the company for the period = 30 +36 +28 +32+36 =162 million)

⇒ The company has recorded profits greater than or equal to 30 Million $ for four out of five years.(statement is true because year 2012-2013, 2013-2014 , 2016 -2017 , 2017-2018 profit greater than 30 million $)
